name: 销售额
definition: 订购数量 × 单件销售价格的合计，按下单日期归属，不扣除退货
formula: SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price) FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end

name: 销售成本
definition: 订购数量 × 单件成本价的合计，按下单日期归属
formula: SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_cost) FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end

name: 毛利
definition: 销售额减去销售成本，按下单日期归属，不扣除退货
formula: SUM(o.quantity * (o.unit_price - o.unit_cost)) FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end

name: 毛利率
definition: 毛利 ÷ 销售额 × 100，按下单日期归属，不扣除退货
formula: SUM(o.quantity * (o.unit_price - o.unit_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price), 0) * 100 FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end

name: 退货率
definition: 按件数算：退货数量合计 ÷ 订购数量合计 × 100，按下单日期归属
formula: SUM(o.return_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(o.quantity), 0) * 100 FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end

name: 库存周转率
definition: 按数量算：当月销售件数 ÷ 当月平均库存件数。平均库存件数 = 当月每天各产品 (期初库存 + 期末库存) / 2 的合计，再按天数平均。库存表只有数量，没有成本
formula: (SELECT SUM(o.quantity) FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM((i.opening_qty + i.closing_qty) / 2) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.stat_date) FROM dabench.inventory i WHERE i.stat_date >= :start AND i.stat_date < :end), 0)

name: 复购率
definition: 当月下单 2 笔及以上的客户数 ÷ 当月下单的客户数 × 100，订单数按订单编号去重
formula: SUM(t.orders >= 2) / COUNT(*) * 100 FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM dabench.orders o WHERE o.order_date >= :start AND o.order_date < :end GROUP BY o.customer_id) t

name: 线索转化漏斗
aliases: 漏斗,转化率,转换率,环节转化率
definition: 线索的转化路径：线索 → 有效线索（is_valid = 1）→ 到店（is_visited = 1）→ 试驾（is_test_driven = 1）→ 订单（is_ordered = 1）→ 交付（order_status = '已交车'）。两个环节之间的转换率 = 后一环节的数量 ÷ 前一环节的数量，按线索创建日期归属
formula: COUNT(*) AS 线索, SUM(c.is_valid) AS 有效线索, SUM(c.is_visited) AS 到店, SUM(c.is_test_driven) AS 试驾, SUM(c.is_ordered) AS 订单, SUM(c.order_status = '已交车') AS 交付 FROM dabench.car_leads c WHERE c.created_date >= :start AND c.created_date < :end

name: 成单数
definition: 完成车辆交付且没有被退单的线索数，也就是订单状态为已交车；只下订单未交付不算，按线索创建日期归属
formula: COUNT(*) FROM dabench.car_leads c WHERE c.order_status = '已交车' AND c.created_date >= :start AND c.created_date < :end

name: 订单利润
definition: 成单线索（订单状态为已交车）的车型利润合计，按线索创建日期归属
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_status = '已交车' THEN c.model_profit ELSE 0 END) FROM dabench.car_leads c WHERE c.created_date >= :start AND c.created_date < :end

name: 线索ROI
aliases: ROI,投资回报率,线索投资回报率
definition: 投资回报率 = (订单利润 − 线索价格) / 线索价格。订单利润只算成单线索的车型利润，线索价格是这些线索的线索成本合计，按线索创建日期归属
formula: (SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_status = '已交车' THEN c.model_profit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(c.lead_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.lead_cost), 0) FROM dabench.car_leads c WHERE c.created_date >= :start AND c.created_date < :end

name: 闪电单
definition: 订单创建日期（下定日期）− 线索创建日期 ≤ 7 天的订单，按线索创建日期归属
formula: COUNT(*) FROM dabench.car_leads c WHERE c.is_ordered = 1 AND DATEDIFF(c.order_date, c.created_date) <= 7 AND c.created_date >= :start AND c.created_date < :end

name: 客户评级
aliases: 客户等级,ABC评级,A级客户,B级客户,C级客户
definition: 按计划购车时间分类：A 级（Active）3 个月内，即 1周内、1个月内、1-3个月；B 级（Basic）3-6个月；C 级（Cold）6 个月以上或暂不确定，即 6-12个月、1年以上、暂不确定
formula: CASE WHEN c.purchase_plan IN ('1周内', '1个月内', '1-3个月') THEN 'A' WHEN c.purchase_plan = '3-6个月' THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END FROM dabench.car_leads c

name: 贷款通过率
definition: 贷款状态为 Approved 的申请数 ÷ 申请数 × 100，按申请日期归属
formula: SUM(l.loan_status = 'Approved') / COUNT(*) * 100 FROM dabench.loan_applications l WHERE l.application_date >= :start AND l.application_date < :end

name: 平均利率
aliases: 申贷通过的平均利率,平均贷款利率
definition: 申请通过（贷款状态为 Approved）的贷款的平均利率，按申请日期归属
formula: AVG(l.interest_rate) FROM dabench.loan_applications l WHERE l.loan_status = 'Approved' AND l.application_date >= :start AND l.application_date < :end

name: 高利贷
definition: 利率 > 法定利率 × 4，法定利率为 3%，即利率高于 12%，按申请日期归属
formula: COUNT(*) FROM dabench.loan_applications l WHERE l.interest_rate > 12 AND l.application_date >= :start AND l.application_date < :end

name: 欺诈率
definition: 欺诈标识为 1 的申请数 ÷ 申请数 × 100，按申请日期归属
formula: SUM(l.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) * 100 FROM dabench.loan_applications l WHERE l.application_date >= :start AND l.application_date < :end
